title: site.yaml
description: The input of `pnpm init-site` (scripts/init-site.mjs): everything the init script needs to turn a copy of tl-template-website into one site's repository. Published facts only: no budget, prices, offers or personal data. Template-only: init-site deletes this file with site.yaml.

name.description: The site's name, shown in the header and in every page title (site.config.ts name).

domain.description: The production domain, lower case, without `www.` and without a scheme. The site's address is https://<domain> (site.config.ts url).

repo.description: The GitHub repository, <owner>/<name>, for example TrislabCompany/trislab-website-dragonja. The name becomes the package name; the owner is the organisation of the code owners team.

github_team.description: The team (without the organisation) that owns the repository, for .github/CODEOWNERS: @<owner>/<github_team>. The devops team is added for the platform's files.

template.description: The template release this repository is made from. init-site writes it to .template-version, where update-from-template reads it.

version.description: The release tag without the `template-website/` prefix, for example v0.4.0.

commit.description: The full SHA of the release tag's commit.

languages.description: The site's languages. The first is the default language, which `/` leads to. Only languages the template has interface strings for (src/i18n/ui/): sl, en, hr, sr (Latin script), it, de. The other packs are deleted.

description.description: The default description of a page, one sentence or two, in every language of `languages`.

company.description: The company the site publishes in its imprint, contact page and structured data. Published data only.

legal_name.description: The registered name, for example `Example d.o.o.`.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, for example SI.

registration_number.description: The company registration number, as published in the imprint.

vat_id.description: The VAT identification number, as published in the imprint.

imprint_notes.description: Other lines the law asks for in the imprint (court register, share capital...). Each line is written in every language.

profiles.description: Profiles of the company elsewhere (LinkedIn, GitHub...), as absolute https URLs.

contact.description: How visitors reach the company. Role mailboxes only (info@, sales@): never a person's name, e-mail address or phone number.

topics.description: E-mail by topic, shown on the contact page and the imprint.

label.description: What this mailbox is for, in every language.

security_email.description: The role mailbox for security reports, published in /.well-known/security.txt. init-site sets the expiry date a year (less a month) ahead.

map_url.description: A plain https link to a map. Nothing is embedded.

google_business_url.description: The company's Google Business profile, an https URL.

legal_pages.description: Which legal pages the site has. Each defaults to true. The texts are drafts in src/content/legal/<language>/ that a lawyer must review.

structured_data.description: The JSON-LD on every page. Default Organization.

collections.description: The lists of items kept as Markdown (src/content/<id>/<language>/), at least one: the pages and types of the template assume a list. Each gets a list page, an item page, a home section and a menu link as `nav` and `home` say. init-site writes the content collection for each id and no items.

id.description: The folder in src/content/ and the first part of the address, kebab-case, for example `services`. Not a page the template already has.

title.description: The list's heading, menu entry and home section heading, in every language.

lead.description: One sentence under the heading, in every language.

nav.description: A link in the main menu. Default true.

home.description: A section with the items on the home page. Default true.

theme.description: The brand. Every value is optional; the template's neutral sample is kept for what is missing. init-site checks the contrast the way tokens.css asks.

theme_color.description: The colour of the address bar on a phone, #rrggbb. Default: the background.

muted.description: Secondary text: 4.5:1 on background and surface.

accent_text.description: The accent as text: 4.5:1 on background and surface.

accent_contrast.description: Text on a button in the accent colour: 4.5:1 on accent.

localized.description: A text per language. It has exactly the languages of `languages`; init-site checks that.
